description: raw-recurrence-mellum-v8 with the latent policy's memory-lean optimizer in the text stages: backbone weight matrices step under LionSR (one BF16 momentum, stochastic-rounding writes, per-row step qat_latent_lr x the row's ternary scale; conversion v3's optimizer and rate 3e-4), heads and norms on Muon/AdamW. run-v7's backbone phase refused at its first update: Muon's BF16 latents would also lose updates below BF16 resolution (no stochastic rounding), and its preflight forecast 115 GB from projection-phase calibration.
